proof_skeleton: Assume Keller pair not injective; collision variety V nonempty.
Theorem 1.2 (Prop 2.15): after automorphism, |y1|+|y2| = o(h) on V.
Theorem 1.3: pi1: V -> C^2 proper, finite, surjective.
Proposition 3.7: nonempty compact V0 subset V (V1 from (3.16) or V2 from (3.17)) with continuous l and (3.18).
Proposition 3.12: every point of V0 has nearby points of V0 with strictly larger l (IFT perturbation + two-inequality parameter choice).
Extreme value theorem contradiction: l has no maximum on nonempty compact V0, yet must attain one.
scope_limits: Prose/logical-gap pass, not formal verification. Main chain, decisive estimates, and perturbation engine re-derived by hand; Proposition 3.7's routine inequality bookkeeping read structurally, not exhaustively re-derived. No defect found in any decisive inference.
